cases.local_answer:
The ledger check on the sample found four attachments, with three rows that would be logged. Nothing was written to a ledger.

| Attachment | Invoice | Status | Duplicate? | Logged? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| complete.pdf | NW-2026-118 | Complete | No | Yes |
| cover-letter.pdf | None | Failed | No | No, skipped |
| duplicate.pdf | FAB-1043 | Complete | Yes, of INV-ROW-0001 | Yes |
| partial.pdf | CS-5521 | Partial | No | Yes |

**Rows that would be added:**
- **NW-2026-118**, Northwind Traders, 2026-11-03, 4,820.00 USD, complete
- **FAB-1043**, Fabrikam Supplies, 2026-10-28, 1,250.00 USD, complete, flagged as a duplicate of INV-ROW-0001
- **CS-5521**, Contoso Services, 975.00, partial. The invoice date and currency are missing.

The tool marks FAB-1043 as a duplicate but still says to log it. A person should decide whether it belongs in the ledger before anything is written.
